streams.standard: own failures off by 3-6 x tolerance
streams.stress: own failures off by 3-40 x tolerance

k_selection: max balanced accuracy on calibration seeds, standard stream; ties -> larger K
pass: balanced accuracy > baseline in >=4/5 test seeds (standard)
false-MIXED rate < baseline in >=4/5 test seeds on both streams
stress: mean missed-failure rise <= .10 and balanced accuracy lower in at most 1/5 seeds
change: residual against nearest open numeric prediction on the channel, then ceiling K
